news.t: PS Medico build 47 (%d %b %Y): 30 more medicine sources checked, and the alternatives are guaranteed pure - Netforhealth (1,000 small-maker medicines) and the first Dawaadost wave joined the online lists; 9 more big sites (Apollo 24/7, HealthKart, SastaSundar, TrueMeds...) honestly refuse automated access. And per the builder's instruction: alternatives come ONLY from the verified catalog of rated makers - internet-added medicines can never appear as alternatives (printed on every table, enforced by an automated test).
